tools.name: define
tools.description: Define the Dutch word 'tachtien' (a cardinal number meaning 'ontelbaar veel', uncountably many): syllables, part of speech, IPA pronunciation, definition and origin, as on tachtien.nl. Content is in Dutch.

tools.name: examples
tools.description: Example sentences that use 'tachtien', in Dutch. Each example is a short dialogue of one or more lines.

tools.name: mentions
tools.description: External mentions of 'tachtien' (tweets, press and Cityguys articles) with title, source and URL. The url is null for a mention without a link.

tools.name: tachtienify
tools.description: Rewrite a text so that vague large amounts in Dutch or English ('heel veel', 'honderden', 'a lot of', 'countless', ...) and large estimates ('ongeveer honderd', '~200', '100+') become 'tachtien'. Exact numbers, small estimates and years are left alone. Returns the new text, the number of replacement

tools.name: is_tachtien
tools.description: Judge whether an amount counts as 'tachtien' (uncountably many) and give a tongue-in-cheek reason in Dutch. Exact numbers never do (18 is achttien, 80 is tachtig, also inside a phrase like '18 biertjes'). Vague amounts like 'heel veel' or 'geen idee' do, and so do estimates of 50 or more, lower boun
